Emily / Kimberly — attaching a short worksheet and three commercial options so procurement has clean choices. High-level:

Option A — Provisional bucket (3 months)
- Small committed bucket for Jan–Mar to absorb burst.
- No co-term; priced at list minus 10% for provisional commitment.
- Monthly true-up possible; no onboarding credit.

Option B — Staged annualize (6-month bridge then annualize)
- Upfront 6-month provisional commitment that converts pro-rata into an annual commitment on co-terming.
- Discount: list minus 18% on converted portion.
- One-time onboarding credit of $12,500 applied as invoice credit to smooth rollout.

Option C — Immediate annualize + co-term trade
- Convert uplift into an immediate 12-month add-on that co-terms to June renewal; requires 12-month extension on base term.
- Discount: list minus 25% on uplift committed units.
- In exchange: we offer a holdback credit (5% of uplift value) released after 90 days if usage trend matches forecast.

Billing & proration notes:
- If starting mid-cycle, we prorate the first invoice to the activation date.
- We can accommodate procurement POs; DocuSign for amendment preferred to lock pricing.

Attached: Provisional_Uplift_Worksheet.xlsx (xlsx) — includes line-by-line pricing, token assumptions, and a conversion calculator.

If any of these look promising I can convert Option B/C into a redlined amendment for legal.
